decisions.reason: The pipe bracket is a cheap, simple addition close to the core pipeline business, and with growing industry turnover and some slack there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search to cut it.

The public waste bin is distant from the core, but it uses the firm's existing powder-coating and fabrication capacity and sells to municipal customers the firm already serves, so slack lets it carry the product while results are still uncertain.

This multi-model waste bin line with ashtray is a distant diversification with uncertain results, but it shares production and customers with the other street-furniture products and has not clearly fallen below aspiration, so it is kept for now.

The outdoor ashtray line carries the highest risk of missing aspirations because it is far from the core and serves a niche market, but it is cheap to keep alongside the bins while the firm's slack lasts.
